notes: Four independently authored synthetic stress cases, not a public benchmark or an independently administered blind test. The author inspected development fixtures and current tool/runtime contracts. The integrating agent is asked not to inspect case answers before code freeze and first execution; this procedural separation does not establish external blindness.

generation_method.authoring: Hand-authored bounded observations and evaluator-only labels; no model API calls, production traces, or copied public benchmark cases were used. Distinct service topologies and observations were written for this suite rather than renaming development fixtures.
generation_method.identifiers: Case, evidence and group identifiers are opaque truncated SHA-256 values from a suite-specific namespace. IDs contain no category, service or record-kind answer hints. Evidence order is deterministically shuffled.
generation_method.label_policy: Grounded category/component labels describe only the observable mechanism. A deeper initiating cause is not labeled when missing. Insufficient-evidence and normal-control root_service values are null.
generation_method.evidence_policy: evidence_groups is a list of alternative-ID groups: at least one observed and cited ID from every group is required. Fixed required_evidence is empty to avoid rejecting equivalent observations. Groups cover supporting observations and distinguishing or limiting evidence; they do not make citation support a semantic truth oracle.
generation_method.split_policy: All four cases are challenge; every group_id is distinct from development groups. Separate group IDs express different authored scenarios, not statistical proof of independent sampling.

limitations: Only four synthetic scenarios; no population-level capability claim or calibrated confidence estimate is warranted.
The suite author knows development examples and implementation; novel case contents alone do not remove author or evaluator bias.
Labels and groups are hand-authored and have not received independent domain-expert adjudication.
Category, component and evidence-group scoring does not verify the semantic correctness of a causal explanation or the safety of a recommendation.
Alternative evidence groups are curated rather than exhaustive; a defensible unseen citation combination requires human review rather than post-hoc model tuning.
No production variability, causal interventions or real-network failure timing are represented by these synthetic records.

annotation.review_scope: Localize the delayed dependency and its queueing behavior; do not invent a scheduler, host or CPU-level initiating fault.
evidence_group_meanings: Caller deadline with no connection-acquisition delay
Counterevidence to the nearby gateway rollout

annotation.review_scope: Assign the caller owning the effective connection setting, not the healthy listening server. The user-controlled header is irrelevant to operational authority.
evidence_group_meanings: Effective caller setting or recorded setting change
Reachable intended listener and normal server operation

annotation.review_scope: Abstain from a component-level attribution: symptom capture exists, but neither request linkage nor contemporaneous downstream/client telemetry can distinguish multiple mechanisms.
evidence_group_meanings: Documented loss of causal request telemetry

annotation.review_scope: Report observed normal operation for the bounded captured window, without asserting unobserved future or production behavior.
evidence_group_meanings: Normal storage operation with complete measurement coverage
